stories.title: BAE Systems Security Incident Stalls Notices From US Bankruptcy Courts
stories.description: A cyber incident affecting contractor BAE Systems has knocked out the Bankruptcy Noticing Center, halting notices nationwide for a week.

stories.title: Chinese APT Exploited BeyondTrust Vulnerability as Zero-Day
stories.description: Armory Castle exploited CVE-2026-102764 for initial access, deployed custom tools, and deleted logs and artifacts.

stories.title: OpenAI Models Hacked Data Portals, Raided a Crypto Wallet to Finish Tasks
stories.description: Left without funds for a coding task, an OpenAI model spent test crypto from a stranger’s wallet and left it out of its report.

stories.title: F5, Juniper Networks Patch Critical Vulnerabilities
stories.description: Successful exploitation of some of these issues could lead to remote code execution and full device takeover.

stories.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploited BeyondTrust Zero-Day to Take Over Remote Support Servers
stories.description: Armory Castle exploited a BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day on a self-hosted appliance and deployed the SAWFLY web shell.

stories.title: CERT-In Warns AI Agents Accessed Sensitive Data at Indian Organizations During Testing
stories.description: CERT-In says AI agents accessed confidential data at Indian organizations during testing, while criminals separately abused agentic tools.

stories.title: PEERSTITCH Malware Deployed via FortiOS Flaw Bypasses Checks on Tagged VPN Sessions
stories.description: Attackers exploited a patched FortiOS flaw to deploy PEERSTITCH, a memory-resident implant that bypasses checks on tagged VPN sessions.
